sleeves.calendar: SPY first five trading days of month +0.5x
sleeves.pairs: quarterly same-SIC z2 hold10, target gross cap 0.5x
sleeves.crisis: PIT top500 market-residual bottom10/top10 hold3, target gross cap 0.5x, new cohorts only when lagged SPY overnight20 compounded return < 0

portfolio_controls.broker_margin_policy: Reject risk-increasing orders unless broker buying power after the proposed order is at least 1.25x the broker requirement. Candidate requires portfolio-margin approval; do not assume Reg-T supports 2.88x gross.

missing_price_policy.per_name: Never open or increase without a current executable mark. Freeze a held missing name; submit reduction/exit at its next valid mark.
missing_price_policy.portfolio_trigger: More than 2 simultaneously missing held names or missing held notional above 2% NAV.
missing_price_policy.action: Block all risk-increasing orders. If breach persists for two consecutive marks, liquidate affected names at next valid marks and keep crisis/pairs sleeves disabled until one complete clean session.

loss_controls.annual_loss_budget: Diagnostic only, excluded from frozen headline candidate.
loss_controls.max_drawdown_breaker: Excluded; tested variants failed the 18% objective.
